tests.procedure: Under strong white light check each received sample container separately on a clean transparent watch glass or glass dish for foreign particles, colour and conformity with the visual specification.

details.usp_stm_text: Very bulky, white powder or relatively dense, white powder or granules (STM); spec sheet (heavy) loaded

tests.procedure: Stepwise solubility (USP descriptive terms): 100 mg sample in a stoppered tube with 0.1 mL solvent, shake 1 min, hold 25.0 ± 0.5 °C for 15 min (repeat once if not dissolved); add 0.9 mL, then 2 mL, then 7 mL solvent with the same shake and hold to classify very soluble / freely soluble / soluble / sparingly soluble; if still undissolved, 10 mg in 10 mL (slightly soluble), then 1 mg in 10 mL (very slightly soluble), else practically insoluble. Repeat with dilute acids and alcohol.

Identification of magnesium (USP <191>): sample solution 50 mg/mL in 3 N hydrochloric acid; add 3 mL of ammonium chloride; neutralised with ammonium carbonate TS a slightly hazy precipitate may form; on subsequent addition of dibasic sodium phosphate TS a white crystalline precipitate forms that is insoluble in 6 N ammonium hydroxide.

Free alkali and soluble salts (USP): boil 2.0 g with 100 mL water for 5 min in a covered beaker, filter while hot, cool and dilute to 100 mL; dilute the filtrate with water to 100 mL. Analysis 1: 50 mL of sample solution, methyl red TS, titrate with 0.10 N sulfuric acid; NMT 2.0 mL consumed. Analysis 2: evaporate 25 mL of sample solution to dryness, dry at 105 °C for 1 h; NMT 10 mg (2.0%) residue.

Limit of calcium by AAS (USP <852>, main method): sample 250 mg magnesium oxide freshly ignited 1 h at 800-900 ± 25 °C, dissolved in 30 mL dilute hydrochloric acid, transferred to a 200-mL flask with 4 mL lanthanum solution and diluted to volume (1.25 mg/mL). Standards 1.0, 5.0, 10.0 and 15.0 µg/mL calcium (each with 20 mL lanthanum solution and 40 mL dilute hydrochloric acid in 1000 mL); blank 4 mL lanthanum solution + 10 mL dilute hydrochloric acid to 200 mL. Calcium hollow-cathode lamp, 422.7 nm, nitrous oxide-acetylene flame; zero on blank; read calibration graph. Calcium (%) = (CS x F / CU) x 100, F = 0.001 mg/µg. Limit NMT 1.1%.

details.acid: 30 mL dilute hydrochloric acid to dissolve
details.standardStock: 249.7 mg calcium carbonate (dried 300 °C, 3 h) in 100 mL with hydrochloric acid, 1.000 mg/mL
details.blank: 4 mL lanthanum solution + 10 mL dilute hydrochloric acid to 200 mL
details.formula: Result = (CS x F / CU) x 100; CS = calcium in sample solution (µg/mL); F = 0.001 mg/µg; CU = magnesium oxide concentration in sample solution (mg/mL, STM text reads magnesium hydroxide)
details.reference: USP <852>; USP 2024 Monograph for Magnesium Oxide

tests.procedure: Limit of iron (USP <241>, procedure 1): standard 1 mL standard iron solution (10 µg Fe) diluted to 45 mL, 2 mL hydrochloric acid; sample 40 mg boiled with 5 mL 2 N nitric acid for 1 min, cooled, diluted to 50 mL; 25 mL of this diluted to 45 mL, 2 mL hydrochloric acid. To each tube add 50 mg ammonium peroxydisulfate and 3 mL ammonium thiocyanate solution, mix. Sample colour not darker than the standard.

details.standard: 1 mL standard iron solution (10 µg Fe) to 45 mL, 2 mL hydrochloric acid
details.nitricAcid: 5 mL 2 N nitric acid, boil 1 min

tests.procedure: Loss on ignition (USP <733>): weigh an empty crucible previously ignited at 800-900 ± 25 °C and cooled in desiccator (W0); weigh accurately 1.000 g into it (W1); ignite in a calibrated muffle at 800-900 ± 25 °C for 2 h, cool in desiccator, weigh (W2); repeat to constant weight. % loss on ignition = (W1 - W2) / (W1 - W0) x 100.

Acid-insoluble substances (USP): 2.0 g sample (W1) mixed with 75 mL water in an ignited crucible of known weight (W2); add hydrochloric acid in small portions with agitation until no more dissolves; boil 5 min; if residue remains, filter and wash with water until the washings are free from chloride; ignite and weigh (W3). Residue (%) = (W3 - W2) / W1 x 100. Limit NMT 2 mg (0.1%).

Assay (USP, direct EDTA titration): ignite a portion to constant weight at 800-900 ± 25 °C; weigh 320 mg of ignited magnesium oxide into a 100-mL flask, dissolve in 20 mL 2 N hydrochloric acid and dilute to volume (stock). Transfer 20.0 mL of stock to a 500-mL flask and dilute to 300 mL (equivalent to 64 mg ignited magnesium oxide). Add 10 mL ammonium chloride buffer pH 10 and 50 mg eriochrome black T-sodium chloride indicator; heat to 40 °C; titrate with 0.1 M edetate disodium VS to a blue end point (visual); blank correction (VS). VCa = (W x LCa) / (FCa x 100); Result (%) = (VS - VCa) x (FMgO / W) x 100, with FCa = 4.008 mg, FMgO = 4.030 mg per mL of titrant, W = mg of ignited magnesium oxide in the sample solution, LCa = calcium content from the limit of calcium test.

details.stockSample: 320 mg ignited magnesium oxide in 100 mL, dissolved in 20 mL 2 N hydrochloric acid
details.aliquot: 20.0 mL of stock to 500 mL, dilute to 300 mL
details.indicator: 50 mg eriochrome black T-sodium chloride indicator
details.titrantStandardization: about 400 mg calcium carbonate (dried 210 °C, 4 h) dissolved in dilute hydrochloric acid, ~30 mL 0.1 M edetate disodium, pH 12-13 with sodium hydroxide TS, 300 mg hydroxy naphthol blue, titrate to blue end point; M = gCaCO3 x (Assay/100) x 1000 / (100.09 x mL EDTA)
details.equivalence: FCa = 4.008 mg calcium per mL; FMgO = 4.030 mg magnesium oxide per mL
details.reference: USP Reagents, Indicators, and Solutions - Indicator and Test Papers

tests.procedure: Bulk density: weigh an empty dry cylinder, set the balance to zero, put 10 mL of the powder into the cylinder and weigh. Bulk density (g/mL) = weight of sample / volume (10 mL).

details.usp_stm_text: 5 g occupies about 5 mL (about 1 g/mL); spec sheet in-house text loaded

tests.procedure: Particle size distribution: by calibrated analytical sieving or particle size analyser; measure the mass percentage of powder in each sieve size range. In-house specification: D10 297 µm (10% pass through 50 mesh); D50 590 µm (50% pass through 30 mesh); D90 1000 µm (90% pass through 18 mesh).

details.method: calibrated analytical sieving or particle size analyser
details.reference: In-house specification by R&D department for PSD
